summary: Study it during a Long Rest to dream a d20 roll you can use in place of one later.
text: While this tapestry hangs within 30 feet of you, you can study it for 1 hour during a Long Rest and record a d20 roll. Until your next Long Rest you can use that number in place of one of your D20 Tests before rolling. It also records the name and appearance of anyone who casts Dream on you, and while you're Unconscious within 30 feet of it you have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

powers.name: Dream on It
powers.text: During a Long Rest: record a d20 roll.

powers.name: Use the Dream
powers.text: Your next D20 Test uses the number you dreamed.
